summary: Full backend + frontend testing of new 'Servis Güzergahı' (routes) category. Created /app/backend/tests/test_routes.py with 9 tests covering seed list, route ordering (feed/cities/report not shadowed by /{rid}), CRUD, register/re-register/unregister flow, report per-stop counts, and city filter — all 9 passed. Frontend Playwright run verified: employee /ic-iletisim shows Servis Güzergahı card; /ic-iletisim/servis lists 2 seeded routes; search filter works (Kadıköy→1 card); city chips present; route detail shows data-testid=route-map iframe and stop timeline; clicking a route-stop-select-<id> registers (Kaydımı kaldır appears), unregister removes it. Admin panel tab admin-tab-routes opens RoutesManager; created TEST_UI_Route with 2 stops via UI, deleted via AlertDialog confirm (verified removed via API); Rapor button opens RouteReport with per-route/per-stop breakdown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1600 lines; consider splitting Servis Güzergahı endpoints into a dedicated router module for maintainability.

POST /api/routes accepts arbitrary category assignment via seed-only categories lookup; if seed hasn't run category_id will be None (works currently because seed runs on startup) — acceptable but note the coupling.
DELETE /api/routes/{rid} returns {ok:true} even if the route does not exist (idempotent). Fine, but a 404 might be more consistent with the rest of the API which raises on missing PUT/GET.

register_route only validates route existence, not that stop_id belongs to the route — an employee could register with a bogus stop_id and stop_name would return empty. Consider validating stop_id ∈ route.stops.
test_credentials: No auth; role-switcher via localStorage keys pln_role=admin|employee and pln_emp=<employee_id>.
seed_data_creation: TEST_UI_Route was created and cleanly deleted during UI test. Test_routes.py backend TEST_ data also cleaned up in its delete test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Servis Güzergahı module fully functional. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_routes.py. Frontend selectors used: route-card-<id>, route-map, route-stop-select-<id>, route-unregister, admin-tab-routes, add-route-btn, route-name-input, route-city-input, route-plate-input, route-driver-input, route-driverphone-input, route-add-stop, route-stop-name-<i>, route-stop-time-<i>, route-save-btn, route-del-<id>, route-del-confirm-<id>, routes-report-btn, route-report. Role via localStorage bypass works reliably.
